title: Publication-time pre-registration of near-term framework falsification handles
framing: These five predictions are pre-registered at publication freeze time with the content hash above. Any reviewer can recompute the hash from the downloaded bundled state to verify that the predictions were stamped before the indicated decisive-release experiments reported their results. The framework's central claim is that all five predictions either confirm (values land inside the bands) or jointly fail (the chirality-running CC closure, the System-R neutrino-mass closure, and the structural H_0 lock are coupled through the same six discrete-geometric primitives).

predictions.falsification_threshold: |w_a| > 0.1 confirmed at > 5 sigma falsifies the eps_sync^4 / gamma closure
